name: whatitbroke-monorepo
description: Universal Application Debugger and Root-Cause Analysis Ecosystem

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['packages', 'examples'].forEach(dir => fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(pkg => { const p = `${dir}/${pkg}/dist`; if (fs.existsSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p, {recursive: true, force: true}); }));"
